To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

workspace awareness is a complex phenomenon, which is composed of three types of knowledge: knowledge about other people’s work, knowledge about the workspace, and knowledge about the relationship between people and workspace, that is used to support collaboration in the shared workspace.
workspace awareness is an important part of the usability of groupware, and that designers can use our descriptive framework to design and evaluate awareness support in groupwork.

(1) workspace awareness is a set of knowledge elements about the activities and intentions of others; (2) it is maintained by perceptual mechanisms that are triggered by changes in the workspace; (3) workspace awareness is used to make decisions about how to act in the workspace, to make sense of the workspace, and to communicate with others.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of groupware systems that support awareness of others.
understanding the concept of awareness and with developing a framework that helps designers understand and support awareness in groupware.
the design and evaluation of groupware that supports the awareness of others.

this paper presents a descriptive framework of workspace awareness for real-time groupware, and that it can be used to describe other kinds of awareness.
awareness of others is a key to successful groupware use.
the theory of awareness developed in this paper is an excellent starting point for designers of groupware.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the framework is a descriptive theory of workspace awareness that helps designers understand how to design awareness support in group-ware.
we have provided a descriptive framework of workspace awareness for groupware designers.

the theory of workspace awareness provides a descriptive vocabulary for designers of groupware, which can be used to analyse and compare the awareness mechanisms in groupware, and to explain the usability of groupware in terms of awareness support.

awareness is a complex concept that is difficult to support withsimple mechanisms, and that it is important to consider the fullrange of factors that influence awareness in the design of real-timemultimedia groupware.
